title: Geography at the foot of a chapel
position: Lower base, north and south sides.
question: Why put regions of Egypt under royal ritual scenes?
explanation: The base lists Egyptian regions and their measurements, while personified watery and geographical entities appear elsewhere around it. This creates a different scale of reading: above are royal-divine encounters; below, the ordered landscape contributes to the monument. Do not turn a small photographed sign into a named region until the exact panel and published text are matched.
lookFor: Compare the low horizontal register with the taller scenes on the pillars.

claims.text: The north and south base sides record nomes and measurements.

uncertainties: Exact demonstration photographs and safe on-site viewpoints must be checked before publication.
